title: The Twin Chain Court Canon
summary: A canon of the twin court in which two fields of qi work two chains in one matched and answering rhythm.

title: Azure Basin Methods of the Long Tail
summary: Methods that fill the long tail of the chain with qi like a basin and pour it out in one reaching blow.

title: River Bend Treatise on the Chain Whip
summary: A treatise on casting the chain in the long curves of a river bend so that no guard stands square to the tip.

title: The Hawk Talon Chain Manual
summary: A manual of the barbed tip as a hawk's talon that seizes tears and lifts what it takes from a foe.

title: Paired Orbit Doctrine of the Chain Whip
summary: A doctrine of two orbits of qi-driven chain turning together around one body and opening toward one foe.

title: The Dual-Track Segment Mastery
summary: A mastery of the dual-track segment in which one field drives the body and the other drives every link.

title: Oath Bearings of the Wind Chain
summary: Bearings sworn on the wind that let a Xiantian wielder throw the chain along a line the gale cannot bend.

title: Plateau Edge Chain Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of fighting at the plateau's edge where the chain rides the updraft and the footing is all or nothing.

title: The Gale Bearing Long Chain Mastery
summary: A mastery course in the gale bearing that extends the chain by qi and holds its line across a wide plateau.

title: Unwalled Wind Chain Course
summary: A course that sets the qi field open to the wind so the chain flies with it and takes no shelter.

title: Treatise of the Sworn Wind Tether
summary: A treatise on tethering a foe to a sworn bearing so that the wind and the chain together hold the foe fast.

title: The Open Plateau Chain Canon
summary: A canon of the open plateau that teaches the field and chain to give ground and take it back in one oath.
